song_ids = [s['song_id'] for s in songs]
print('song_ids', song_ids)
# fetch play_count for each
plays=[]
for s in songs:
    detail = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=s['song_id'])
    plays.append({
        'song_id': s['song_id'],
        'title': s.get('title'),
        'play_count': detail.get('play_count'),
        'added_at': s.get('added_at')
    })
print('fetched', len(plays))
print('rows:')
for row in plays:
    print(row)
min_play = min(r['play_count'] for r in plays)
print('min_play', min_play)
# first song with min_play in library order
least = next(r for r in plays if r['play_count']==min_play)
print('least', least)
least['title']
